The document presents Core Tier 1 capital 37,193 and a Core Tier 1 ratio of 12.0% (37,193/310,299 = 11.99%), but Core Tier 1 is the Basel II/FSA measure, materially more lenient than CRD IV CET1 (Lloyds' own 2013 restatement put CRD IV CET1 at 10.3% against a much higher Core Tier 1), so it is deliberately not recorded in the cet1 fields - consistent with how the Bendigo Basel II answers treat the absence of CET1. No leverage ratio or LCR existed in this report. Tier 1 and total capital are Basel II measures too and not strictly comparable with 2014 onwards.
